web.title: Television in Ecuador
web.description:
## History
[ [edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Television_in_Ecuador&action=edit&section=1)]

Television in Ecuador started by initiative of José Rosenbaum, a German Jew who fled to Ecuador to escape persecution by Nazi Germany. Together with his wife, Linda Zambrano, from Manabí, they travelled to a fair in [Hanover](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanover) to buy equipment for the first television station. The station was initially set to be in [Quito](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quito), but due to lack of public awareness, the station moved to [Guayaquil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guayaquil).

[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Television_in_Ecuador#cite_note-UISEK-3)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Television_in_Ecuador#cite_note-:1-4) Its launch was marked by a lack of television regulations, which were officially imposed on December 5, 1959.

The network gained a second station in Quito (channel 8) in 1970.

In 1977, Telenacional began broadcasting.
